claim: A single omniseek_search call with the frozen need as the query returns text containing the claim key.
frozen_need: We depend on about a dozen small open-source projects and I've been told to "just pay them," except our finance team can't process a donation and procurement needs a vendor with an invoice, a tax form, and a signed contract. I want to hear from companies that actually got money out the door: what legal structure they used, what argument got an unincorporated individual maintainer through vendor onboarding, and roughly what a defensible per-project amount looks like on a budget line. Every write-up I find stops at "sponsor your dependencies" and skips the part where procurement says no.
